ReadContract.summary: The ONLY read endpoint Elevate exposes. Object selection happens via the BODY field `resource`, NOT the URL path -- the generic REST list/GET-by-path CRUD pattern this framework otherwise assumes does NOT apply to this vendor's reads.

envelope.api_key: string, required. Per-client credential. Travels in the JSON BODY -- not a header, not a query param (see AuthCredentialParamLocation).
envelope.format: string, optional, one of 'json' | 'csv', defaults to 'json'. See csvLimitation.
envelope.resource: string, required. Selects the object.
